name: Rapping Wrapping
body:
Price 2,000 gp; Slot none; CL 12th; Weight —; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

When this sheet of wrapping paper is manually pressed against a locked door, box, or chest, the target is affected by the knock spell (caster level 12th). Whether the spell succeeds or not, the rapping wrapping is destroyed after being used in this way.

Alternatively, a sheet of rapping wrapping can function like a scroll of knock (caster level 12th).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Scribe Scroll; Spells knock
